These exact byte fixtures are a local engineering reference from one public
TypeScript Wallet/StorageClient `listActions` call to the authenticated owned Go
host, captured on 2026-11-12. They are not Chromium/native wallet qualification
or a whole-action membership oracle. `cwiJoin` remains `UNAVAILABLE`.

The source-bound reference receipt is retained in
`out/native-closure-20261111/action-ledger-reference/review.json` (SHA256
04e3e9562c51f8bc59b1bfcfbd086ae76af230b532b68b1b4beb21b74be21f8b).
The binary SHA256 was
28f36290a56fc261219888c4824262996f4d7619da5fb7cd434ccf1dc9f211a1.
This sample precedes the additive UseNumber precision correction; the correction
preserves these safe-integer bytes and separately tests large-number retention.


`wdk-args.json` is a laboratory-only byte capture of Go1.27.3's actual pinned `wdk.ListActionsArgs` JSON decoding and marshaling, produced by `generate-wdk-args.go.txt` with the final caller-known-inputs module replacement. It covers omitted/null/zero fields, pointer flags, duplicate/case-folded fields, retained string-slice elements, uint64 precision and malformed typed arguments. It is not a wallet CWI conformance oracle or native result. The raw request is retained independently; unknown request fields are ignored only by this explicit typed RPC projection.

`rpc-envelope-corpus.json` is generated by the exact `bindActionRPCBytes` function copied from the admitted local host source, with its method filter and the actual pinned `wdk.AuthID`. It checks request/response/auth aliases, duplicate/null/type semantics, raw ID spellings and result/error behavior. The corresponding generator remains adjacent for review; these synthetic controls are not native findings.
